title: Slovakian Stir-Fried Noodles
description: A hearty and flavorful stir-fry recipe featuring Slovakian noodles, vermicelli, and a hint of Asian flair.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic, stir-frying until softened.
Add vermicelli and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly toasted.
Add Slovakian noodles and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add hei and soy sauce, stir-frying until combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer noodles to a serving platter and serve immediately.
Optional: add cooked vegetables or your choice of protein.
